entries.title: Psalms 55:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David.>> Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication. {chief...: or, overseer} {Maschil: or, of instruction}

entries.title: Psalms 55:2
segments: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

entries.title: Psalms 55:3
segments: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:4
segments: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:5
segments: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me. {overwhelmed: Heb. covered}

entries.title: Psalms 55:6
segments: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! [for then] would I fly away, and be at rest.

entries.title: Psalms 55:7
segments: Lo, [then] would I wander far off, [and] remain in the wilderness. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 55:8
segments: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm [and] tempest.

entries.title: Psalms 55:9
segments: ¶Destroy, O Lord, [and] divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

entries.title: Psalms 55:10
segments: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow [are] in the midst of it.

entries.title: Psalms 55:11
segments: Wickedness [is] in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

entries.title: Psalms 55:12
segments: For [it was] not an enemy [that] reproached me; then I could have borne [it]: neither [was it] he that hated me [that] did magnify [himself] against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

words.text: me; then I could have borne
[himself] against me; then I would have hid

entries.title: Psalms 55:13
segments: But [it was] thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance. {mine equal: Heb. according to my rank}

words.text: . {mine equal: Heb. according to my rank}

entries.title: Psalms 55:14
segments: We took sweet counsel together, [and] walked unto the house of God in company. {We...: Heb. Who sweetened counsel}

entries.title: Psalms 55:15
segments: Let death seize upon them, [and] let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness [is] in their dwellings, [and] among them. {hell: or, the grave}

words.text: upon them, [and] let them go down

entries.title: Psalms 55:16
segments: ¶As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

entries.title: Psalms 55:17
segments: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

entries.title: Psalms 55:18
segments: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle [that was] against me: for there were many with me.

words.text: [that was] against me: for there were many

entries.title: Psalms 55:19
segments: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God. {Because...: or, With whom also there be no changes, yet they}

words.text: . {Because...: or, With whom also there be no changes, yet they}

entries.title: Psalms 55:20
segments: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant. {broken: Heb. profaned}

words.text: against such as be at peace

entries.title: Psalms 55:21
segments: [The words] of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war [was] in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet [were] they drawn swords.

entries.title: Psalms 55:22
segments: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved. {burden: or, gift}

entries.title: Psalms 55:23
segments: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee. {bloody...: Heb. men of bloods and deceit} {shall...: Heb. shall not half their days}

words.text: in thee. {bloody...: Heb. men of bloods and deceit} {shall...: Heb. shall not half their days}
